rationale: C11 is the strongest plausible template because it is an earlier letter to the same commission and uses a materially similar closing package: recognition of the commission’s work on reserve and national-security matters, deep personal appreciation for the chairman and his associates, and attention to a commission report. The child adapts that correspondence framework from continued use of the commission’s counsel to acceptance of its expiration. C08 and C18 parallel the acceptance-and-appreciation structure, but concern individual retirements or resignations and lack the same commission-specific material.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the additional duties imposed upon the Commission these past three years in fields relating to the reserve components of the Armed Forces have been completed
shared_material.parent_excerpt: plans for arriving at decisions relative to the size and composition of our reserve forces ... the continued counsel of the National Security Training Commission
shared_material.explanation: Both letters frame the same commission’s role through its work concerning reserve forces.

shared_material.child_excerpt: with a feeling of lasting appreciation to you who for so long have concerned yourselves patriotically and effectively with matters basic to our national strength
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The expression of deep appreciation I feel for the long hours of effort that you and your associates have contributed
shared_material.explanation: The child closely adapts the earlier letter’s commission-directed expression of deep appreciation for sustained collective service.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I look forward to receiving the final report mentioned in the last sentence of the Commission's letter.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the excellent report submitted to me ... Your report will be of great value
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude by coupling appreciation with discussion of a report from the commission.
